passages.note: Third reading floor vote on HB2853, with Martinez recorded as a Yea vote in a non-unanimous 31-26-3-0-0 tally.

passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding section 15-2401, beginning in the 2022-2023 school year, in this chapter, unless the context otherwise requires, "qualified student" includes a resident of this state who both: 1. Is eligible to enroll in a public school in this state in any of the following: ( a ) A preschool program for children with disabilities. ( b ) A kindergarten program. ( c ) Any of grades one through twelve. 2. Does not otherwise qualify for an Arizona empowerment scholarship account pursuant to this chapter.
passages.note: New section 15-2401.01 extends ESA eligibility to any resident eligible to enroll in public school, making the program universal; funds may be used for tuition at nongovernmental qualified schools.
Bill status page lists Martinez as a co-sponsor of HB2853 alongside the prime sponsor and other co-sponsors.

rows.reasoning: Martinez co-sponsored and voted Yea (MARTINEZ Y, 31-26-3-0-0) on HB2853 (2022), a single-subject Arizona empowerment scholarship account bill whose new section 15-2401.01 extends ESA eligibility to any resident eligible to enroll in public school, making the program universal, with funds usable for tuition at nongovernmental qualified schools chosen by the family — matching the rung providing universal vouchers so education funding follows the student to any school, public, private, or religious.
